annotations.title: Assess an AI tool for a task

description: Returns the catalogue efficiency, effectiveness and due diligence for one tool on one task, plus the matching court AI rules. Unlisted tools stay not_recorded.

jurisdiction.description: Optional code: NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, NT or CTH (use CTH for federal forums such as the Federal Court, FCFCOA and the Fair Work Commission). Omit it to be asked. No code is filled in for you.

task.description: The legal task, in a short phrase, with client names removed.

tool.description: The AI product name or catalogue profile id.

name: assess_tool_use
